SELECT hcii.*, ( select hd.PAYMENT_REQ_number FROM csh_payment_Req_hd hd WHERE hd.payment_req_id = hcii.LOAN_APPLICATION_NO ) LOAN_APPLICATION_NO_n, ( select hd.PAYMENT_APPROVED_STATUS FROM csh_payment_Req_hd hd WHERE hd.payment_req_id = hcii.LOAN_APPLICATION_NO ) PAY_STATUS, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'PAYMENT_APPROVED_STATUS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = ( select hd.PAYMENT_APPROVED_STATUS FROM csh_payment_Req_hd hd WHERE hd.payment_req_id = hcii.LOAN_APPLICATION_NO ) ) PAY_STATUS_n, hcii.LOAN_APPLICATION_NO AS PAYMENT_REQ_ID,
( select hd.LOAN_TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM csh_payment_Req_hd hd WHERE hd.payment_req_id = hcii.LOAN_APPLICATION_NO ) APPLY_AMOUNT,
( select hd.ACTUAL_PAY_DATE FROM csh_payment_Req_hd hd WHERE hd.payment_req_id = hcii.LOAN_APPLICATION_NO ) PAY_TIME
FROM hls_capital_investment_info hcii
1=1
and hcii.lease_item_id = #{leaseItemId}
